item.description:
🚨 Boletim de Cyber Segurança - Técnica
Visão geral:

Infraestrutura - Docker / ESX / Elastic / Grafana / Nginx / VMware / Zabbix

🚨 CVE-2026-72585 - Grafana
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Grafana
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
An authorization bypass vulnerability in Grafana through 13.2.0 allows an Editor-role user to delete protected contact points (receivers) without the required alert.notifications.receivers.protected:write permission.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-72585

🚨 CVE-2026-14237 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The vitepos WordPress plugin before 3.6.0, Vitepos WordPress plugin before 3.5.0 do not perform a per-target authorization check in their point-of-sale password-reset API and grant the custom Outlet Manager role an over-broad password-reset capability by default, allowing an Outlet Manager to reset any user's password, including an administrator's, and take over the account.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-14237

The threat actor known as Head Mare has been observed weaponizing security flaws in unpatched TrueConf servers once again in attacks targeting Russian companies spanning instrumentation, electronics, transport, energy, IT, and software development sectors. Russian cybersecurity vendor Kaspersky said it detected the attacks in July 2026. The activity involves exploiting a vulnerability chain
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/head-mare-exploits-trueconf-flaws-to.html

Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
CISA has confirmed that ransomware gangs have begun exploiting two recently patched SonicWall SMA1000 vulnerabilities, including a maximum-severity server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-sonicwall-sma1000-flaws-now-exploited-by-ransomware-gangs/

Criticidade: Alta

Video game publisher and digital distribution giant Valve is notifying Steam hardware customers in Europe that hackers stole their data after hacking its shipping partner, CEVA Logistics.

Sistemas / Cloud - 1Password / Azure / Office / Ubuntu / Windows Server / WordPress

🚨 CVE-2026-15038 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The InfiniteWP Client WordPress plugin before 1.13.6 does not properly verify the site-connection state and the authenticity of requests to its remote-management endpoint on WordPress Multisite installations, allowing unauthenticated attackers to bind their own key, hijack an administrator session, and take over the entire network, leading to remote code execution.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-15038
 
🚨 CVE-2026-68377 - Ubuntu
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: net/sched: act_tunnel_key: Defer dst_release to RCU callback Fix a race-condition use-after-free in tunnel_key_release_params(). The function releases the metadata_dst of the old params synchronously via dst_release() while deferring the params struct free with kfree_rcu(). A concurrent tunnel_key_act() reader on the datapath may still hold the old p...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-68377
